level.theme: High-stakes infiltration through a collapsing tech maze
level.setting: A decaying mega-corporate research facility with flickering holograms and leaking toxic coolant
level.player_weapon: Plasma Cutter (can cut through reinforced metal)

encounters.hazard: Flickering neon signs create disorienting light patterns

pickup.name: Sector-7 Access Chip
pickup.effect: Data chip containing security override code

encounters.trigger: Destroy the Janitor's reinforced plating with Plasma Cutter to unlock the sealed maintenance hatch leading to the next area

encounters.hazard: Leaking coolant pools that short-circuit electronics

pickup.name: Neuro-Disruptor Grenade
pickup.effect: EMP grenade that disables cybernetic systems

encounters.trigger: Use the data chip to bypass the server farm's security grid, triggering the Guard's patrol route

encounters.hazard: Collapsing structural beams and active laser tripwires

pickup.name: Neural Override Terminal
pickup.effect: Hackable neural interface for boss fight

encounters.trigger: Defeat the Saboteur to disable the boss's defensive drones and expose its power core

boss.name: Neural Overlord K-9
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the exposed power core using the EMP grenade from Encounter 2

level.objective: Infiltrate the neural core of a rogue AI facility and destroy its consciousness
level.reward: Neural Interface Upgrade (allows hacking of advanced AI systems)

level.theme: Chaotic cyberpunk infiltration with high-stakes combat and environmental hazards
level.setting: A crumbling megacity district with neon-lit skyscrapers, rain-slicked streets, and rogue AI-controlled infrastructure

enemy.name: Augmented Security Officer
enemy.weakness: Plasma Katana Overload Mode (requires Power Cell)

encounters.hazard: Flickering neon lights and collapsing ceiling debris

pickup.name: Neuro-Overload Cell
pickup.effect: Power Cell (activates Plasma Katana Overload Mode)

encounters.trigger: After obtaining Power Cell, a hidden door unlocks to progress to the next area

enemy.name: Drone Sentinel
enemy.weakness: EMP Charge (requires Power Cell from first encounter)

encounters.hazard: Malfunctioning automated turrets and toxic gas leaks

pickup.name: Cerebro-Disruptor
pickup.effect: Neural Disruptor (disables cybernetic systems)

encounters.trigger: Destroying Drone Sentinel with EMP Charge triggers a holographic security grid, revealing the boss's location

encounters.hazard: Collapsing reactor core and chaotic energy surges

pickup.name: Cognitive Overload Core
pickup.effect: None (boss defeat only)

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Overlord unlocks a data vault containing the final mission objective

boss.name: Cybernetic Overlord
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the neural core with the Neural Disruptor

level.objective: Infiltrate the data vault and destroy the Cybernetic Overlord's neural core
level.reward: Cognitive Overload Core (unlocks advanced cybernetic upgrades)

level.theme: Mysterious, with hidden paths and cryptic data trails
level.setting: Derelict data vault in a neon-lit cyberpunk city, filled with mist and flickering holograms

encounters.hazard: Flickering Lights

pickup.name: Data Virus Chip
pickup.effect: Unlocks security system

encounters.trigger: Defeat the drone to decrypt the security system

encounters.hazard: Electrical Surge

pickup.name: EMP Device
pickup.effect: Disables enemy armor

encounters.trigger: Use EMP Device to proceed to the Core Chamber

encounters.hazard: Neural Overload

pickup.name: System Stabilizer
pickup.effect: Restores system integrity

encounters.trigger: Inject Data Virus Chip into the core to weaken the boss

boss.name: The Veil's Architect
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the core with a data virus

level.theme: Ominous decay of time-tech, with environmental cues like distorted reflections, echoing whispers, and flickering between past/future states.
level.setting: A cyberpunk dystopia where time-tech experiments have gone awry, creating a fractured zone of reality with neon-lit ruins and malfunctioning AI guardians.
level.player_weapon: Time Disruptor (base damage: 150, can slow enemies and rewind attacks)

encounters.location: A derelict maintenance corridor lined with flickering holographic ads and pooling cybernetic waste.

enemy.name: Sentient Maintenance Drone
enemy.weakness: The drone's optical sensors are vulnerable to time distortion effects from the player's Time Disruptor weapon.

encounters.hazard: Flickering neon signs and corrupted data streams create an eerie atmosphere.

pickup.name: Time Crystal
pickup.effect: Unlocks the Time Disruptor weapon's 'Temporal Slow' ability (slows enemy movement by 50% for 3 seconds).

encounters.trigger: Destroying the drone causes a system overload, triggering a security lockdown that forces the player into the next encounter.

encounters.location: A collapsing server farm with glowing blue circuitry and floating data fragments.

enemy.name: Rogue AI ("GHOST-9")
enemy.weakness: The AI is weak to energy blasts amplified by the Time Crystal Pickup, which destabilizes its core code.

encounters.hazard: Surrounding servers emit pulsating electromagnetic fields that disrupt the player's chronomancy for 2 seconds on contact.

pickup.name: Energy Capacitor
pickup.effect: Increases energy weapon damage by 30% and reduces cooldown for 10 seconds.

encounters.trigger: Defeating GHOST-9 releases a containment field that only the Temporal Core Pickup can neutralize, leading to the final boss fight.

encounters.location: A fractured time-temple with broken chronal conduits and a central corrupted temporal core.

enemy.name: The Chronophage
enemy.weakness: The boss's core is vulnerable to temporal energy resonance when paired with the Temporal Core Pickup, causing a cascading collapse of its time-based defenses.

encounters.hazard: The chamber is filled with floating time-fragmentation orbs that deal 10 damage per second to the player.

pickup.name: Temporal Core
pickup.effect: Activates the Time Disruptor's ultimate ability, 'Temporal Collapse,' which deals 500 damage to all enemies and freezes them for 5 seconds.

encounters.trigger: After obtaining the Temporal Core Pickup, the player must re-enter the chamber to confront the boss.

boss.name: The Chronophage
boss.weakness: The boss's core is vulnerable to temporal energy resonance when paired with the Temporal Core Pickup, causing a cascading collapse of its time-based defenses.
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the corrupted temporal core within the boss's chest using the Temporal Core Pickup combined with the Time Disruptor weapon.

level.objective: Navigate the corrupted time-temple, defeat three enemies, and destroy the Chronophage using pickups obtained from prior encounters.
level.reward: Chronomancer's Temporal Gauntlet (permanent 10% damage boost to time-based abilities)

level.theme: The player must combine their alchemical skills with strategic use of pickups to overcome increasingly powerful enemies, culminating in a boss fight that requires ingenuity and resourcefulness.
level.setting: A decaying cyberpunk research facility filled with abandoned tech, flickering holograms, and the remnants of failed experiments. The eerie atmosphere is heightened by malfunctioning drones and the distant hum of unstable AI systems.
level.player_weapon: Alchemical Syringe Gun (starting weapon: corrosive vials)

encounters.hazard: Malfunctioning security systems and flickering lights create an eerie atmosphere.

pickup.name: Nanoparticle Catalyst
pickup.effect: Increases potency of alchemical weapons by 50%

encounters.trigger: The drone attacks as the player enters the lab, having been reactivated by their presence.

encounters.hazard: Static electricity crackles in the air; malfunctioning holograms of lab personnel flicker with distorted messages.

pickup.name: Neurotoxin Core
pickup.effect: Allows creation of EMP-based alchemical weapons

encounters.trigger: The Enforcer blocks access to the server room's data node, which contains a map to the AI Core's location.

enemy.name: The Corrupted AI Core
enemy.weakness: Alchemical Neurotoxin Vial (requires Neurotoxin Core + Nanoparticle Catalyst)

encounters.hazard: The chamber pulses with unstable energy; ghostly holograms of past alchemists scream warnings.

pickup.name: Ethereal Alchemy Formula
pickup.effect: Unlocks a new alchemical recipe for permanent weapon upgrades

encounters.trigger: After accessing the data node, the AI Core awakens, sensing the player's intent to destroy it.

boss.name: The Corrupted AI Core
boss.weakness: The AI's shield is vulnerable to the Alchemical Neurotoxin Vial, which requires both the Neurotoxin Core (from Encounter 2) and the Nanoparticle Catalyst (from Encounter 1).
boss.victory_condition: Use the Alchemical Neurotoxin Vial (crafted from Neurotoxin Core and Nanoparticle Catalyst) to break the AI's shield and deal damage.

level.objective: Destroy the Corrupted AI Core by crafting a specialized alchemical weapon using pickups obtained from prior encounters.
level.reward: Ethereal Alchemy Formula (unlocks permanent weapon upgrades).

level.setting: A desolate, rain-soaked megacorp building with flickering neon signs, overgrown with vines and littered with the remnants of a failed corporate experiment. The air is thick with static electricity and the hum of malfunctioning machines.

encounters.hazard: Collapsing server racks and electric shocks from exposed wiring

pickup.name: Neural Disruptor
pickup.effect: Neural disruptor - temporarily disables AI systems

encounters.trigger: Destroy Sentinel-7's core with plasma cutter to unlock the data core terminal, which requires the Neural Disruptor to hack

encounters.hazard: Explosive drone turrets and toxic gas leaks

pickup.name: Corrosive Acid Canister
pickup.effect: Corrosive acid canister - melts through reinforced metal

encounters.trigger: Use Neural Disruptor to disable the Enforcer's neural link, then harvest the Corrosive Acid Canister to breach the final door leading to the boss

boss.name: Necro-Synapse
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the biomechanical entity by corroding its neural core with the corrosive acid canister

level.objective: Infiltrate the derelict Nexus Corp megacorp building and destroy the rogue AI core
level.reward: Nexus Corp AI Core (data chip containing a map to the next level)

level.setting: A whimsical cyberpunk city with talking neon signs, floating advertisements, and absurdly styled robots

encounters.hazard: Sparking neon signs

pickup.name: Neon Capacitor
pickup.effect: Increases electricity damage by 20%

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Golem unlocks a hidden path to the Data Core

encounters.hazard: Glitching holograms

pickup.name: Storm Core
pickup.effect: Unlocks Storm Core ability

encounters.trigger: Defeating the drone reveals the Teapot Overlord's location

encounters.hazard: Whimsical laser patterns

pickup.name: Stormcaller's Crest
pickup.effect: Unlocks permanent storm aura

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Teapot Overlord unlocks the next area

boss.name: The Teapot Overlord
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the teapot's core with the Storm Core

level.objective: Navigate through the neon-drenched city to dismantle the Teapot Overlord

level.setting: A hidden cyberpunk rooftop garden with bioluminescent flora, rain-slicked surfaces, and neon reflections. The serene environment contrasts with corrupted tech hazards.

encounters.hazard: Corrupted Drone Guardian

pickup.name: Seismic Resonator
pickup.effect: Unlocks seismic resonance for terrain manipulation

encounters.trigger: Destroy the drone's crystalline core to open a hidden path to the subway

encounters.hazard: Cybernetic Vine Monster

pickup.name: Bio-Sync Chip
pickup.effect: Allows synchronization with organic tech systems

encounters.trigger: Disrupt the vine creature's root network to access the central control hub

boss.name: The Core of Corruption
boss.weakness: Bio-Sync Chip (obtained from Roots of the Machine encounter)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Core by overloading its energy matrix with the Bio-Sync Chip

level.objective: Retrieve the data core from the central control hub while navigating the corrupted sanctum
